items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: No, I would say more of the school of Pierron or possibly the old tuxedo bands of Celestan and Wrigley.

ctx.x: Would they be of the school of Pierron or more like Buddy Petit?
No, I would say more of the school of Pierron or possibly the old tuxedo bands of Celestan and Wrigley.
If you can give me the date on that, that would be good too.
